def normshape(cells):
    cells=set(cells)
    rmin=min(a for a,b in cells); cmin=min(b for a,b in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((a-rmin,b-cmin) for a,b in cells))
import math
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    Ii=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; Oi=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    O_=objs(Ii)
    chg=[x for x in O_ if any(Oi[r][c]!=Ii[r][c] for r,c in x[1])][0]
    tg=Oi[list(chg[1])[0][0]][list(chg[1])[0][1]]
    tw=[o for o in O_ if o is not chg and normshape(o[1])==normshape(chg[1])]
    assert len(tw)==1, (p,tw)
    t=tw[0]
    # segment from changed centroid to twin centroid
    ca=sum(a for a,b in chg[1])/len(chg[1]); cb=sum(b for a,b in chg[1])/len(chg[1])
    ta=sum(a for a,b in t[1])/len(t[1]); tb=sum(b for a,b in t[1])/len(t[1])
    best=None
    for u in O_:
        if u is chg or u is t: continue
        ua=sum(a for a,b in u[1])/len(u[1]); ub=sum(b for a,b in u[1])/len(u[1])
        # min distance from segment ca..ta,cb..tb to point ua,ub
        s=math.sqrt((ca-ta)**2+(cb-tb)**2)
        v=math.cos((ta-ca)/s)*(ua-ca)+math.sin((ta-ca)/s)*(ub-cb)
        w=math.sin(-(ta-ca)/s)*(ua-ca)+math.cos(-(ta-ca)/s)*(ub-cb)
        d=abs(w) if -s<=v<=s else max(abs(v-s),abs(v+s))
        bd=len(u[1])
        cand=(d,-bd,u[0])
        if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
    print(p,'twin',t[0],'target',tg,'nearest-between-object color:',best)

    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); out=[]

            col=I[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]

def bbox(cs): return (min(a for a,b in cs),max(a for a,b in cs),min(b for a,b in cs),max(b for a,b in cs))
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    Ii=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; Oi=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    Co=comps(Ii)
    chg=[o for o in Co if any(not (Oi[r][c]==Ii[r][c]) for r,c in o[1])][0]
    tg=Oi[list(chg[1])[0][0]][list(chg[1])[0][1]]
    twins=[o for o in Co if o is not chg and normshape(o[1])==normshape(chg[1])]
    t=twins[0]
    # target comp in input
    tgt=[o for o in Co if o[0]==tg and o is not chg]
    tgtc=tgt[0][1] if tgt else None
    sb=bbox(chg[1]); tb=bbox(t[1])
    def b_overlap(a,b):
        ra,rb,ca,cb=a; ea,eb,cc,cd=b
        return not(ea<ra or cb>ca or cd<cc or eb<ra or cd<cc)  # placeholder
    def bb_intr(a,b):
        ra,ra1,ca,ca1=a; rb,rb1,cb,cb1=b
        return max(ra,rb)<=min(ra1,rb1) and max(ca,cb)<=min(ca1,cb1)
    tin=bbox(tgtc) if tgtc else None
    print('=== pair',p,'chg',chg[0],'twin',t[0],'->',tg)
    print('  chg bbox',sb,'twin bbox',tb,'tgtbbox',tin)
    print('  chg_in_tgt',bb_intr(sb,tin) if tin else None,'twin_in_tgt',bb_intr(tb,tin) if tin else None)
    # closest among ALL comps to changed object
    best=min((min(abs(a-b)+abs(c-d) for a,c in chg[1] for b,d in u[1]),u[0],len(u[1])) for u in Co if u is not chg)
    print('  closest comp to chg: color',best[1],'size',best[2],'dist',best[0])

def normshape(cs):
    rmin=min(a for a,b in cs); cmin=min(b for a,b in cs)
    return tuple(sorted((a-rmin,b-cmin) for a,b in cs))
def f(I):
    Hh,Ww=len(I),len(I[0])
    Co=comps(I)
    cnt={}
    for x in Co: cnt.setdefault(x[0],[]).append(x)
    # duplicate shape groups (excluding singletons of bg?) - use all comps, shape groups with >1 same shape AND distinct objects
    groups={}
    for x in Co:
        groups.setdefault(normshape(x[1]),[]).append(x)
    dup_groups=[v for v in groups.values() if len(v)>1 and len(v[0][1])>1]
    # candidate anchors: unique-color comps whose bbox contains a dup member's bbox
    anchors=[]
    for key,v in groups.items():
        if len(v)!=2: continue
        a1,a2=v
        for c,x in Co:
            if x is a1 or x is a2: continue
            ub=bbox(x[1]); sb=bbox(a1[1])
            if not (ub[0]>=sb[0] and ub[1]<=sb[1] and ub[2]>=sb[2] and ub[3]<=sb[3]): continue
            # color must be unique in input (exactly one comp of that color, or the anchor is the only comp)
            if len(cnt.get(c,[]))!=1: continue
            anchors.append((c,x))
    assert len(anchors)==1,(anchors)
    tc,anch=anchors[0]
    # which dup member is inside anch bbox -> recolor the other
    mb=None; oth=None
    for key,v in groups.items():
        if len(v)!=2: continue
        for m in v:
            if bbox(m[1])[0]>=bbox(anch[1])[0] and bbox(m[1])[1]<=bbox(anch[1])[1] and bbox(m[1])[2]>=bbox(anch[1])[2] and bbox(m[1])[3]<=bbox(anch[1])[3]:
                mb=m
        if mb is None: oth=[m for m in v]
    assert mb is not None
    oth=oth[0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for r,c in oth[1]: O[r][c]=tc
    return O
